fields.title: SIGMAP (DR Congo) publication record
fields.description: One record per publication card found on marchepublic.cd's PrimeFaces DataView grid for the requested listType. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a category's navigation fails.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: Always TENDER_LIST -- SIGMAP does not expose a separate per-publication detail page beyond what's already on this card (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md).

listType.title: List type
listType.description: Which of SIGMAP's own publication-type menu items this record came from, e.g. procurement_plan, call_for_tenders, expression_of_interest.

listGroup.title: List group
listGroup.description: SIGMAP's own top-level grouping for listType: PPM, AAO, AMI, ANO_AS, APPROBATION, or ATTESTATION_REDEVANCE.

categoryCode.title: Category code
categoryCode.description: SIGMAP's own short procurement-category code shown on the card, e.g. MF (Marche de Fournitures/goods), MT (Marche de Travaux/works).

categoryLabel.title: Category label
categoryLabel.description: Human-readable label for categoryCode, e.g. 'Marche de fournitures'.

authority.title: Contracting authority
authority.description: The government body (Autorite Contractante) that issued this publication.

reference.title: Reference number
reference.description: The publication's own reference/dossier number, e.g. 'PPM/MIN.BUDGET/MF/2026/00001'.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description shown on the card (usually repeats authority + reference; SIGMAP's own publications rarely carry more detail than this at recon time).

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Raw publication date text as shown by SIGMAP (dd/mm/yyyy).

pdfUrl.title: Document PDF URL
pdfUrl.description: Direct link to download the original publication document from marchepublic.cd, when SIGMAP provides one.

detailsAvailable.title: Details available
detailsAvailable.description: Whether this card's own 'Details' button was active (not disabled) at scrape time. Every record seen during recon had this disabled -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md for why no detail-page parser was built.
